hits.name: OpenAI
hits.hook: OpenAI: Introducing GPT-6 Cyber for security research; grew from 412K yesterday to 3.48M
hits.text:
Introducing GPT‑6 Cyber: a major advance in security research that pairs stronger capabilities with better model alignment.

The model powered the Linux kernel research we announced yesterday, and security teams at companies like Mozilla, Palo Alto Networks, Calif, and Cisco—alongside our own at OpenAI—are already putting it to work.

GPT-6 Cyber is available to select Daybreak Red customers and we are expanding access over time.

https://t.co/Nzab3Z1Td6

hits.text:
Instead of picking the model for each and every task, let Copilot Fusion route and orchestrate which model to use. ✅

Copilot Fusion balances performance and cost efficiency, picking from three execution patterns for the job: Single, Cascade, or Critique. All you need to do is choose the effort level.

GitHub Copilot Fusion picks the model for you: Single, Cascade or Critique. You just set the effort level.

6. Cursor launched live app building with automatic hosting, Postgres and authentication.

7. Google announced a $17 BILLION Wyoming data center.

8. Dropbox acquired Tigris Data for $350M to expand its AI infrastructure.

9. Perplexity launched Teammates, proactive AI agents that handle ongoing work and collaborate through Slack.

10. Microsoft demonstrated local AI coding with Qwen3.8-27B through GitHub Copilot.

Which one deserves a deeper dive?

virals.name: Aziz Ai
virals.hook: Is your tech stack ready for the 2026–2030 shift? 🚀
virals.text:
Is your tech stack ready for the 2026–2030 shift? 🚀

We are witnessing a massive transition across 11 key digital workflows:

1️⃣ **Search:** Google Search ➔ Perplexity ➔ AI Search Agents
2️⃣ **Conversational AI:** ChatGPT ➔ Claude ➔ Personal AI Agents
3️⃣ **Document Analysis:** Reading PDFs ➔ NotebookLM ➔ Autonomous Research Agents
4️⃣ **Vector Design:** Adobe Illustrator ➔ Figma AI ➔ Midjourney 7
5️⃣ **Photo Editing:** Adobe Photoshop ➔ Nano Banana ➔ Flux AI
6️⃣ **Presentations:** PowerPoint ➔ Gamma ➔ AI Presentation Agents
7️⃣ **Inputs:** Physical Keyboards ➔ Wispr Flow ➔ Multimodal AI Interfaces
8️⃣ **Data Analysis:** Microsoft Excel ➔ Julius AI ➔ Autonomous Data Analysts
9️⃣ **Web Browsing:** Google Chrome ➔ Arc Browser ➔ AI Agent Browsers
🔟 **Video Editing:** Adobe Premiere ➔ OpusClip ➔ AI Video Studios
1️⃣1️⃣ **Coding:** GitHub Copilot ➔ Windsurf ➔ Autonomous Coding Agents

Notice the pattern?
• **2026:** Human-driven tools with assisted features

drafts.rides: @OpenAI GPT-6 Cyber (3,478,612 views) + @gdb Nov 12 cyber day (40,045) + outside: Defender on Copilot Studio agents
drafts.text:
GPT-6 Cyber is the story of the week, and Greg Brockman flagged Nov 12 as cyber day.

Closer to home: Microsoft Defender can now block a malicious tool call mid-run on a Copilot Studio agent.

Before that day lands, pick one production agent and ask: what can it touch, who owns the kill switch, and does Defender see it?
drafts.video_tip: Vertical 18s: a Copilot Studio agent run freezes on a red 'tool call blocked' banner, then a checklist of Owner / Permissions / Kill switch ticks on. Caption: 'Cyber day starts with one agent'.

drafts.text:
GitHub Copilot Fusion picks the model for you: Single, Cascade or Critique. You just set the effort level.

Power Platform makers have been doing this by hand for a year - cheap model for classify, smarter one for the messy step.

If Fusion lands in Copilot Studio next, the skill to practice is naming the effort, not picking the model.
drafts.video_tip: Screen 15s: three lanes labeled Single / Cascade / Critique, a sticky note slides into 'Cascade', then a Copilot Studio agent card. Caption: 'Effort first, model second'.

drafts.rides: @clamanna Claude in EU Copilot (12,862 views) + your EU quote (3,995)
drafts.text:
Claude is coming to Microsoft Copilot for EU and EFTA customers, with processing inside the EU Data Boundary.

That is the sentence a lot of European stakeholders have been waiting for.

If you have been parking Copilot projects over residency, this is the week to reopen the conversation - auto model router included.
drafts.video_tip: Talking head 15s with a simple map of EU/EFTA and a 'Data Boundary' stamp. Caption: 'Same Copilot, residency intact'.

drafts.text:
GitHub just launched Copilot Verified Proficiency. No exam. It scores how you actually work with Copilot.

I want the Copilot Studio version of this. Not a badge for finishing a module - a quiet score based on real agent runs, published flows and how often you had to roll them back.

Show me the work, not the certificate.
drafts.video_tip: Split 20s: left a timed exam timer, right a live agent Monitor view with a rising proficiency bar. Caption: 'No quiz. Just the runs'.

drafts.text:
Mustafa Suleyman's warning about Delaware letting AI agents run companies as their own legal entities jumped from 11K to 57K views overnight.

People are paying attention.

My bar is still boring on purpose: every Copilot Studio agent gets a named owner, an identity and an off switch before it gets a budget.
drafts.video_tip: Talking head 12s, three stamps land: Owner, Identity, Off switch. Caption: 'Bank account can wait'.
